        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TellAssistant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CallCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Interested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CallNext</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_1" name="Leads to work on" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckLeads" name="Check the open leads" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TellAssistant" name="Tell the Sales Assistant to call the contact persons of the leads" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallCustomer" name="Call each customer" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessLead" name="Process the lead" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallNext" name="Call the next customer" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_1" name="Lead processed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_1" targetRef="Task_CheckLeads" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckLeads" targetRef="Task_SelectLeads" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectLeads" targetRef="Task_TellAssistant" />
